name: Security Cloud
summary: Connects Jamf Security Cloud to this Jamf Pro tenant (UEM Connect) and creates a Mac activation profile — Security Cloud then syncs devices and can push the enrollment profile into Jamf Pro.

settings.title: Activation profile name
settings.description: Shown in Jamf Security Cloud. Renaming later replaces the profile and mints a new activation code.

settings.title: Content controls
settings.description: Web content filtering capabilities for enrolling devices.

settings.title: Network security
settings.description: Network threat protection capabilities for enrolling devices.

settings.title: Send device risk back to Jamf Pro
settings.description: Device risk levels flow back into Jamf Pro (extension attributes), usable in smart groups.

settings.title: Sync interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often Security Cloud syncs devices from Jamf Pro. Security Cloud only accepts the intervals its own admin UI offers (60 is always valid).

objectsCreated: 1 UEM Connect integration (Security Cloud ↔ this Jamf Pro tenant)
entitlementNote: Needs a Jamf Security Cloud entitlement on the environment. Without it, the deploy stops with a clear message and nothing else is affected.
